notes.title: NEW GAME: 👽 Alien Morgue has been announced!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058959/406a102df148deb851bfa1dc5c4dec4f8d65e423.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello hello! 👋[/p][p][/p][p]I'm very happy to announce my new game 👽 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3885910/Alien_Morgue/?utm_source=my_games&utm_campaign=announcement"]Alien Morgue[/url] 👽 Sci-fi pathologist simulator game where you identify aliens, perform autopsies to determine the cause of death and deal with ethical choices.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45182390/8d133f031ca19d977f43956fb63138895defacf3.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Key Features:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Play as a pathologist for aliens in a sci-fi environment[/p][/*][*][p]Identify the victims by their body features and stuff[/p][/*][*][p]Determine the real cause of death using tools for analysis[/p][/*][*][p]Use the database to guide you through the characteristics of dozens of different races[/p][/*][*][p]Handle bodies and their things according to protocols or the last will[/p][/*][*][p]Choose to fulfill the authorities’ requests or help the victim's family in their time of need[/p][/*][*][p]Don’t get too personal and stay sane — you will need to save some money to buy treatments[/p][/*][*][p]Discover multiple endings depending on your choices[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]⚡ Wishlist on Steam: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3885910/Alien_Morgue/?utm_source=my_games&utm_campaign=announcement"][/dynamiclink][/p]

Hi there!

If you like playing Tidy Backpack and don't mind trying something new from me, here is your lucky day :)
My new game Birdfull, a relaxing and cozy idle game about watching birds, has been launched! 🥳

https://youtu.be/9ueodrjWuXc

🎉 To celebrate the release, I'm offering a 10% launch discount! If you like playing Birdfull and want to support me further, buy the game as a gift for a friend!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3194890/Birdfull/

I really appreciate your incredible support!! I hope these charming birds will bring joy and comfort to your life! :)


Follow the developer:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/bgg]BurGum Games[/url]

notes.title: Update 1.0.1: Polish and Japanese languages and minor fixes
notes.notes:
I am happy to announce that we finally added Polish and Japanese languages to Tidy Backpack!

By the way, this was only possible thanks to our players who reached us in [url=https://discord.gg/8tCnUDsfr3]our Discord[/url] and offered to help with translation <3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058959/de8eda3f50990e1b0d92634e30231e516d1494a8.png[/img]

That is looking incredible!

Patch notes:
- text fixes in Turkish
- text fixes in German
- added Discord button in main menu

Enjoy the game ✨

notes.title: Tidy Backpack is OUT NOW!!!
notes.notes:
Hi hi hi!! ✨

Are you still curious about what happened? Tidy Backpack is out now!!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058959/31310e44f5ad9aa62137c8b4c753b2716bda311b.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45058959/31310e44f5ad9aa62137c8b4c753b2716bda311b.gif[/img][/url]

This is our first game and we're very very excited about its release. We couldn't believe that we could launch our own game and receive such warmhearted feedback from you. In fact, it was partly you who made this game what it is now.

A huge thank you to the cozy wholesome community who supported us along the way! You're awesome, guys!! 💚❤️

And don't forget to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2F8tCnUDsfr3]join our Discord server[/url] to stay tuned about future updates, news, games (?!) and just to chat!

That's it, please go and enjoy Tidy Backpack 🎒


— Artem & Valeria aka BurGum Games

notes.title: Demo 2.0 is out, my friends!
notes.notes:
Hi hi hi! And hi to you!

We're very very close to the release of Tidy Backpack. Only 7 days le-e-e-eft... 👻👻👻

Thanks to all your feedbacks we made our game much better. So now it looks and feels nothing like the previous Demo. So since we updated our game drastically it's not fair to leave irrelevant Demo out there. 

Therefore welcome Demo 2.0 which looks exactly like the full version but only has limited content.
